t: About Kaplan
s: In 1951, Leon and Renee Kaplan opened their first toy store in downtown Greensboro, NC. They eventually moved their store, Tiny Town, to Winston-Salem, NC, where they continued to provide toys and unique gifts that help children learn through play. Leon founded Kaplan School Supply in 1968, later becoming Kaplan Early Learning Company.
